heroTagline: UI/UX Designer with an eye for detail. I bring structured thinking and precision to design that works for real people.
aboutQuote: First make it functional, then fast, and then, pretty.
aboutBio:
I'm studying Interaction Design and continually sharpening my craft through the Google UX Design Certificate. Every project I take on is grounded in research first, iteration second, and visual polish only after the behaviour works.

Before moving into UX design, I spent several years working in a structured, process-driven environment — an experience that gave me a strong sense for clear systems and attention to detail.
